soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae brown, thorax, abdomen and legs white tinged with pale brown. Surface of the head covered with fine hairs mixed with several long ones, the tip of the nasus densely covered with short hairs. Head nearly pear-shaped, longer than wide, widest at the posterior third; the posterior margin convex, shallowly concave in the middle. The head together with the nasus about twice as long as the head width. Nasus a round tube extending horizontally forwards in lateral view, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the vertex higher than the tip of the nasus. Mandibles with an apical spine. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, segment 2 or segment 4 shortest. The pronotum about 2.6 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both nearly straight at the middle. Hind tibia longer than the head width.
